The links appear tightly packed, creating a complex pattern of highlights and shadows.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the topology of the links. In AI images, chains often fail because links fuse together or don't actually pass through each other. Check if the 'interlinked' nature is physically valid or just visually suggested by shadows. Also, scrutinize the metallic reflections for inconsistencies that suggest a neural network's approximation of 'shiny' rather than true optical reflection.
